brief:
Israeli naval forces opened fire on Rafah's shoreline in southern Gaza, the Ma'an news agency reported. The bombardment struck the beach area as military operations continued across the territory.

In a separate operation, Israeli troops demolished residential structures in the Qarara neighborhood. The demolitions added to widespread destruction of civilian housing documented throughout Gaza during the ongoing conflict. The strikes on the beach and home demolitions underscore the breadth of military operations in the southern Gaza enclave.
title: Israeli navy fires on Rafah beach as troops demolish Qarara homes
